Introduction/Context

- Tissue/cell line: Colorectal cancer cell lines (CRC cells).
- Assay/contrast: RNA expression–level differential expression analysis (DEG) comparing Cisplatin vs DMSO.
- Dataset/paper reference: Data provided from the file ijms-24-14743-v2_crc_cells_cisplatin_vs_dmso_DEG.csv (CRC cells treated with Cisplatin vs DMSO).
